title: governance/signals.yml
description: Structural validator for Compass's signals.yml - the file that ships the pattern defaults the stop-hook reads (scope-bloat phrases) and the design patterns the review looks for. Projects override by editing their own governance/signals.yml; the schema is the contract.

version.description: Semver. Bump on incompatible schema changes.

scope_bloat_phrases.description: Substrings searched in agent-authored text (devlog, verification-report) by the stop-hook to prompt a re-assessment. Case-insensitive substring match - not regex.

design_smell.description: Advisory patterns assessed by the review at the `verify` stage - judgment, never a gate. A match is a prompt to investigate a potential design problem. Projects extend by editing their own signals.yml.
